thread:
Ava: Quick idea — run a 3-email 'mini-winback + webinar' flow targeted at folks who signed up but didn't open our first email. Goal: re-engage and push to benchmark webinar (May 12). Short, single-CTA emails.

Diego: OK. Proposed segments: 1) New signups (0–7d) 2) Active trials (engaged last 14d) 3) Dormant (30–90d). Different CTA priorities per segment (Register / Watch recording / Start trial).

Molly: Subject line tests? Thinking: 'New: LLM inference benchmark — what it means for cost' vs 'See how we cut token cost in half' — short preview text to match. For winback variant: 'We missed you — 20min benchmark + coffee ☕'.

Samir: I like the second for trials. Recommend dynamic headline + personalized metric token like {{org_name}} and include a localized send-time. Also add a privacy-safe header pixel toggle.

Ava: For tracking, tag campaigns with ga_source=miniwinback and utm_campaign=benchmark_may12. Use the webinar link: https://redwood.in/webinar-may12. We'll need distinct campaign IDs per segment.

Diego: Cadence proposal: Day 0 invite, Day 2 re-send to unopened (light variant), Day 3 short reminder, Day 7 last-chance + recording CTA for no-shows. Send windows: NA 10:00 local, EMEA 11:00 local.

Molly: Copy snippets (short):
- Invite: "Benchmark findings: latency vs cost — join May 12"
- Reminder: "Quick peek: 3 graphs you should see"
- Last chance: "Seats filling — join live or get the recording"
Preheader tests: 'Free benchmark + live Q&A' vs 'Practical cost-saving steps'.

Samir: Tech ops notes: implement a dynamic content block for segment-specific CTA. Personalization token example: `Hi {{first_name}}, we ran a quick check on {{org_name}}` — keep fallback defaults. Add a UTM pattern: utm_source=email&utm_medium=miniwinback&utm_campaign=benchmark_may12&utm_term={{segment}}. Also enable header pixel control for EU recipients.

Ava: I'll update the campaign brief and drop it in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/miniwinback — can everyone review by EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup: 

Diego: Will review and add send-window rules.

Molly: Adding subject A/B examples and preheader combos in the doc now.

Samir: I'll add the personalization token snippets and the dynamic block spec.

CampaignScheduler: campaign created (ID cw-22045), draft scheduled.

Ava: Thanks all :party_parrot:
